label: Detailed payload / ordinary PCB

label: 17km pressure sensitivity
description: Pressure8790Pa; same prescribed air temperature, radiation, wind and mission so only density/convection changes. Not an actual route replay.

label: Cold payload / startup interlock
description: Only payload package/plate start−40°C; payload operation inhibited until all package cases exceed−5°C.30s sensor and5s delivered heater response.

description: Payload heater reads10K too warm during coldstartup; standbyloads remainenabled while the idealtrue-state readinessgate inhibitsfullworkload.

description: Cold startup with no payload heater; readiness gate remains active. This case is allowed to fail service.

label: Payload heater stuck on
description: 240W delivered continuously; tests upper-temperature margin and excess energy use.

label: Damaged PCB thermal interface
description: Conservative whole assembly reverts to ordinary PCB/pad paths; thermal derating is enabled. This does not represent one isolated failed solder joint.

label: Reserve-driven payload shedding
description: Illustrative40%workload policy when SOC<65%; shows energy versus communications service trade.
